Hi Lydia — appreciate the specific asks. Quick answers from ops & channel: 

- Channel margin handling: The private-offer net price provided to Acme assumes Redwood absorbs a 10% channel uplift internally when we reserve commit capacity (we call this the dedicated channel discount). If you require an explicit reseller line, you can add a reseller fee row; Redwood will not increase the price on the private offer but the PO line can show an administrative pass-through.

- Invoice entity: We can issue from Redwood Inc. US (TIN on file). If Acme prefers reseller invoicing, we need the reseller W-9 and an attestation that the reseller will accept liability for tax withholdings.

- Metering equivalency: for S1 vs S3, we recommend a usage addendum that clarifies which token buckets map to which meters. That keeps billing aligned and avoids double-counting.

I've attached a channel_margin_workback.xlsx that shows the math and a PO_template.pdf with the reseller row example. Laura — can finance confirm whether routing to a reseller will delay onboarding (we've seen a 7–10 day gap previously)?
